name: Work type
description: The kind of construction a permit covers. Telling a new build apart from an alteration turns permit data into a real measure of housing supply, not just a compliance record.

hasDefinedTerm.name: Alteration
hasDefinedTerm.description: Changing a structure, inside or out, without making it bigger.

hasDefinedTerm.name: Change of use
hasDefinedTerm.description: Changing how a structure is used, without any physical work.

hasDefinedTerm.name: Repair
hasDefinedTerm.description: Restoring a structure to its earlier condition.

hasDefinedTerm.name: Temporary
hasDefinedTerm.description: Work or structures meant to last only a limited time.
